count <- read.csv("merged_bacteria.csv",row.names=1)
dim(count)
meta <- read.csv("metadata.csv")
sample_cols <- which(colnames(count) %in% meta$Sample)
head(sample_cols)
identical(colnames(count),meta$Sample)
n <- length(sample_cols)
n
presence <- rowSums(count[, sample_cols] > 0)
prevalence <- presence / n
keep <- prevalence >= 0.9
filtered <- count[keep,]
write.csv(filtered, "merged_bacteria_90%_prevalence.csv")
